recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Announces Quarterly Dividend of US$0.0169 per Share
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental declared a quarterly cash dividend of US$0.0169 per subordinate voting share and multiple voting share. The dividend will be paid on July 31, 2026, to shareholders of record as of July 13, 2026.
